description: BikeZ-ETH: Multi-Modal Trajectory Dataset for Urban Traffic Flow in Zürich, Switzerland is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Shaimaa K. El-Baklish, Ying-Chuan Ni (ETH Zurich). This dataset captures diversified urban road traffic environments in Zürich, Switzerland, by collecting trajectories through drone-based experiments. It goes beyond car-only or bicycle-only observations by also capturing the multimodal interaction in mixed-traffic conditions. The dataset comprises over 100,000 trajectories, including both bicycles and vehicles, captured across 48.1 hours of observation. Coverage: national (CH); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
